description: Two agents over the Nomos analysis: review of paradigms and practices, and speed of functions with ways to optimize them. Includes the Nomos MCP server.
participant.review: Reviews code for agreement with its paradigms and with practices and approaches
participant.performance: Estimates the speed of functions and proposes optimizations
participant.command.changes: Only the code changed against git
config.provider.vscodeLm: A language model available in VS Code (GitHub Copilot or another provider); no key needed.
config.provider.anthropic: Claude through the Anthropic API with your key (command "Set Anthropic API Key" or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).
config.scope.changes: Only the code changed against git: the branch since the default branch, uncommitted and new files.
config.review.scope: What the review agent looks at when the chat command does not say.
config.performance.scope: What the performance agent looks at when the chat command does not say.
config.base: Commit or branch to compare the changed code with. Empty: the merge base with the default branch.
config.contextCharacters: Largest size of the context sent to the model, in characters. Functions that do not fit are named in the answer.
config.vscodeLm.family: Model family for the commands, for example gpt-4o or claude-sonnet-4. Empty: the first available model. In the chat the chosen model is used.
config.anthropic.effort: How much the model thinks: low is faster and cheaper, max is the most thorough.
